Name: OpenAI Codex Vibe Coding
Description: Real-time OpenAI Codex agent status monitor & Vibe Coding controller

com.vibecoding.codex.status.Name: Agent Live Status
com.vibecoding.codex.status.Tooltip: Displays live OpenAI Codex status (Idle / Running / Waiting Approval / Done) and focuses the active IDE or terminal session

com.vibecoding.codex.approval.Name: Prompt Response (Approve / Session / Stop)
com.vibecoding.codex.approval.Tooltip: Approve (y / Enter), Always Allow Session (a), or Stop Immediately (Esc / Ctrl+C)

com.vibecoding.codex.model.Name: Model Switcher (GPT-6.1 Sol / Astra)
com.vibecoding.codex.model.Tooltip: Cycle or lock GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Terra, or GPT-6 Luna

com.vibecoding.codex.mode.Name: Approval, Effort & Sandbox
com.vibecoding.codex.mode.Tooltip: Cycle Approval Policy (On-Request / Auto-Edit / Full-Auto), Reasoning Effort (Low~XHigh), or Sandbox Mode

com.vibecoding.codex.command.Name: Slash Command & Prompt
com.vibecoding.codex.command.Tooltip: Send /review, /compact, /new, /diff, /ide, or custom vibe prompts to the active session

com.vibecoding.codex.utility.Name: Vibe Utility (Voice / Paste / Hooks)
com.vibecoding.codex.utility.Tooltip: Voice Dictation (Win+H / macOS Dictation), Paste Screenshot (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V), Focus Codex, or Auto-Install Hooks
